settings.title: Session Navigator
settings.setOpenModeHint: Where it opens by default; applies from the next launch.
settings.setOpenPanelHint: Opens the panel over the current window; Esc closes it.
settings.setOpenDetachedHint: Opens in its own window, which is handier; needs the Electron component.
settings.setOpenDetachedBlocked: The separate window needs the Electron component — see “Electron component” below.
settings.setOpenFailed: This build of DSH does not let a plugin open Settings — open Settings from the sidebar instead.
settings.setOpenedInHost: Settings opened in the main DSH window — the separate window has no settings page.
settings.setOpenHostSilent: The request went out but no DSH page was listening — the main window may be closed. Open Settings from the sidebar in DSH.
settings.setOpenHostFailed: Could not ask DSH to open Settings — open it from the sidebar in the main DSH window.
settings.setAutoCollapseHint: Fold a folder's siblings once you enter it; off keeps everything expanded.
settings.setShowArchivedHint: When off, archived sessions are no longer listed at the bottom.
settings.setHideBlankHint: These sessions hold just a launch record and no content; DSH hides them by default, so turn this off to delete them by hand.
settings.setSubagentsHint: Folded, subagent sessions tuck under their parent and free up list space.
settings.setDateFormatHint: Detailed date shows “XX-XX XX:XX”; relative time follows DSH's own “X days”.
settings.setSizeFormatHint: Auto switches between B / KB / MB / GB; fixed KB follows the Windows habit.
settings.setSizeAutoHint: Switches between B / KB / MB / GB.
settings.setSizeKbHint: Follows the Windows habit — one unit everywhere.
settings.aiModelNone: This DSH has no model available yet: set up a provider and its credentials in DSH first.
settings.aiEffortHint: Pick an effort level that fits.
settings.aiEffortDefaultHint: Use the model's own default effort.
settings.aiFieldsHint: The input is the conversation text plus the model's own tool results; tags prefer the library you already have.
settings.aiRunPendingHint: {pending} sessions still need a description or tags; {summaries} have been generated.
settings.aiSpendHint: {runs} calls, {failed} of them failed; pricing is the provider's own billing.
settings.aiQueued: Queued {count} sessions; they are generated one at a time.
settings.aiNothingPending: Every session already has a description and tags.
settings.aiStopped: Stopped; the fields already written are kept.
settings.setIndexIdleHint: Read the logs in slices while the panel is idle, so the first conversation-content search does not wait. Off means the index is built only when you search.
settings.setIndexRebuildHint: Delete the current index and build it again.
settings.setIndexClearHint: Delete the index file and drop the in-memory index; the next conversation-content search reads the logs again.
settings.setIndexClearedNone: There was no index cache to delete
settings.setHeaderStyleHint: How big the buttons beside the session title are; Auto lays them out to the window width.
settings.setHeaderAutoHint: Icon plus word while the header is wide enough; icon alone once it gets narrow.
settings.setHeaderIconHint: Draw the glyph alone at every width, leaving more room for the session title.
settings.setCompDownloadingUnknown: Downloading the Electron component ({done} so far)
settings.setCompLeftover: The component is disabled, but a file is still held open (a scanner or the search indexer). It is cleaned up automatically on the next start, and reinstalling reuses those files instead of downloading again.
settings.setCompScanNone: No reusable Electron found; download the component instead.
settings.setCompBorrowNote: Now using another plugin's Electron component.
settings.setSizingHint: Fixed keeps its pixels whatever the DSH window does; percentage follows it.
settings.setSizingPercentHint: Spreads by a percentage of the DSH window.
settings.setSizeHint: Small 860×560 · Medium 1100×720 · Large 1320×820 · XL 1600×960; clamped to the viewport.
settings.setSizePercentHint: A share of the browser viewport; 100% fills it.
settings.setDimHint: ⚠⚠⚠If translucent controls from theme plugins make text hard to read, pull it to the max; 0 turns the scrim off.
settings.setDataDirHint: The whole directory can move elsewhere; the data comes along.
settings.setDataDirPlanMove: Same disk: the old directory is deleted once the copy is complete.
settings.setDataDirPlanCopy: Different disk: the old directory is kept with a .location pointer.
settings.setDataDirMoved: Migration complete; the old directory was removed.
settings.setDataDirCopied: Migration complete; the old directory was kept.
settings.setDataDirFailed: Migration failed and was rolled back to the original directory.
settings.setPickUnavailable: This environment provides no directory picker.
settings.setEnvOverride: DSH_SE_DATA_DIR overrides the stored directory, so migration is ignored.
settings.setNotesFailed: Could not read the release notes: {reason}
settings.setCacheClearHint: The plugin’s own caches and temp files; sessions, trash and quarantine stay.
settings.setCacheSkipped: Component is installing; its download folder was skipped.
settings.setStar: Star the project, thanks for the support
settings.setResetHint: Deletes tree, tags, notes, settings and trash; sessions and Electron are kept.
settings.hdrDeleteMessage: The session moves to the explorer's trash, where it can be restored.
